name: Crafty Meerkat Analytics
author: sortedsol

sections.description:
Crafty Meerkat is website analytics with an AI advisor built in. Instead of handing you 200 reports, it reads your data and sends you a prioritized weekly action plan: what to fix, what to double down on, and why.

This plugin adds the lightweight Crafty Meerkat tracking snippet to your WordPress site. The default tracking is cookieless.

What you get:

  • A weekly AI action plan based on your real traffic
  • Stats Chat: ask questions about your analytics in plain English
  • Uptime monitoring with instant down/recovery alerts
  • Page-speed tracking and broken-link detection
  • AI-assistant traffic attribution (ChatGPT, Perplexity, and more)
  • AI crawler visibility: see when GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and friends read your pages
  • One-click llms.txt hosting, so AI assistants can cite your business accurately
  • Live visitor view with a world map and TV wallboard mode

A Crafty Meerkat account is required. Every plan starts with a free 30-day trial at craftymeerkat.com.

External services

This plugin connects to Crafty Meerkat, a third-party analytics service, to measure traffic on your site. It loads the tracking script from https://t.craftymeerkat.com/v1/t.js, and that script sends anonymous pageview data from the site being measured (page URL, referrer, screen size, browser language, campaign parameters, and any events you configure) to https://t.craftymeerkat.com/v1/collect, tagged with your Site Key. The default tracking sets no cookies; a small localStorage entry is used for same-day campaign attribution. Data is sent on every public page load once a Site Key is configured; nothing is sent from the WordPress admin, and no data is transmitted until you enter a Site Key.

When “AI crawler visits” is enabled (the default), requests whose user-agent identifies a known AI crawler (such as GPTBot or ClaudeBot) are reported server-side to https://den.craftymeerkat.com/api/collect-bots; only the crawler name, the page path, and your Site Key are sent, never visitor data. When “Serve llms.txt” is enabled, the plugin fetches your generated llms.txt from https://den.craftymeerkat.com/api/llms-txt/public and serves it at your site’s /llms.txt.

The service is operated by Crafty Meerkat:

  • Privacy policy: https://www.craftymeerkat.com/privacy
  • Terms of service: https://www.craftymeerkat.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings, then Crafty Meerkat.
  3. Paste your Site Key (from your Crafty Meerkat dashboard under Settings, then Install Snippet).
  4. Save. That’s it. Data appears in your dashboard within a few minutes.
sections.faq:
Do I need a cookie banner?

The default tracking is cookieless and does not store personal data in the browser, so in most jurisdictions an analytics consent popup is not required. Review your own compliance requirements.

Does it slow my site down?

The script is ~6KB, loads async, and is served from a CDN-backed endpoint. It has no measurable effect on page speed.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Unchecking a settings checkbox now stores an explicit “0” instead of relying on an empty value.
  • Added uninstall.php: plugin options and cached data are removed when the plugin is deleted.
  • Declared “Requires at least” and “Requires PHP” in the plugin file header so WordPress can enforce compatibility at install time.
  • Copy polish on the settings page and in this readme.

1.1.0

  • AI crawler visibility: counts visits from AI assistant crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and more) so they appear in your dashboard’s AI Visibility page. These crawlers never run JavaScript, so only a server-side plugin can see them.
  • llms.txt hosting: serve the llms.txt file generated in your Crafty Meerkat dashboard at your site’s /llms.txt with one checkbox, no file uploads needed.

1.0.4

  • Text domain changed to crafty-meerkat-analytics to match the plugin slug.

1.0.3

  • Updated plugin contributor metadata.

1.0.2

  • Added an External services section documenting the t.craftymeerkat.com tracking endpoint, the data sent, and links to the privacy policy and terms.

1.0.1

  • Tracker script is now registered via wp_enqueue_script() with a version parameter.
  • Declared compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: snippet injection, settings page, admin exclusion option.
